title: Errors in the official record that Tiro 1 identified
about: Five passages in printed congressional hearing records (GPO prints on govinfo) where the print credits the words to the wrong person, and Tiro 1 named the person who spoke. Each item gives the exact print bytes (SHA-256), the wrong header lines and a verbatim excerpt with line numbers, quote-level evidence from the print itself, an evidence-strength rating, and the video with timestamps. Items 2-5 can be checked from the print text alone. Item 1 needs the video.
found_in: Items 1-4 were found in HillGenius's September 2026 backlog run of hearings outside the public test. Item 5 was found in the October 2026 public test of 100 hearings.
line_numbering: Line numbers are 1-based lines of the htm bytes at print_text_url (https://api.govinfo.gov/packages/<CHRG>/htm, which needs a free api.data.gov key). print_sha256 is the hash of those bytes; two fetches gave identical bytes. The same text is at govinfo_html_url, but www.govinfo.gov rewrites email addresses on each fetch, so that copy's bytes and hash can differ. Its line numbers are the same: every wrong header line here sits at the same line number in the govinfo_html_url copy (checked October 27, 2026).
